name: Basic E Inc.
old_description: is the best choice for fast skilled repair work on a variety of industrial equipment.
about:
Basic E Inc. operates from Charlotte, Vermont, where it maintains a 34,000‑square‑foot warehouse. The company describes itself as a unique distributor of electronic components, electrical parts, and industrial items, with franchised lines that carry certificates of compliance and full traceability. (No founding year or ownership details are disclosed.)

The firm stocks over 86,000 line items, ranging from passives and electro‑mechanicals to actives, obsolete new parts, military‑spec components, and wire‑and‑cable. Beyond distribution, it offers repair services for industrial equipment, custom cable and harness assembly built to customer specifications, and an asset‑recovery program that purchases excess new inventory outright for cash.

Its customer base includes more than 35 nuclear power plants and electric generating utilities, along with military and defense buyers seeking MIL‑SPEC parts. The company also serves general industrial markets needing motors, valves, relays, circuit boards, semiconductors, and a broad range of electrical and electronic components.

Basic E emphasizes fast, skilled repair work and same‑day access to hard‑to‑find obsolete parts as key differentiators. Its franchised partnerships with brands such as Barker Microfarads and Capteks capacitors, combined with a large on‑hand inventory, are presented as the reasons customers choose the company.
